motifs.label: Threshold crossing
motifs.description: Crossing a marked boundary changes the social, bodily or cosmological state of the crosser.
motifs.motifeme: boundary crossing changes permitted state

motifs.label: Forbidden place
motifs.description: A place is marked as dangerous or prohibited, and violation produces consequence or revelation.
motifs.motifeme: access to a place is normatively barred

motifs.label: Return with transformation
motifs.description: A traveler returns from elsewhere altered in body, status, memory, age or allegiance.
motifs.motifeme: return follows irreversible alteration

motifs.label: One-way passage
motifs.description: A boundary or journey is easy in one direction but costly, delayed or impossible in reverse.
motifs.motifeme: passage can be crossed in only one direction

motifs.label: Hospitality threshold

motifs.motifeme: entry depends on host-guest obligation

motifs.label: Contagious mark

motifs.motifeme: contact transmits a visible or social mark

motifs.label: Polluted place

motifs.motifeme: place retains harmful contamination

motifs.label: Irreversible bodily change

motifs.motifeme: body change cannot be fully reversed

motifs.label: Borrowed form

motifs.motifeme: identity temporarily occupies another form

motifs.label: Double or substitute self

motifs.motifeme: one identity is represented by a second self

motifs.label: Transformation by incorporation

motifs.motifeme: incorporation of another changes the self

motifs.label: Forbidden knowledge

motifs.motifeme: knowledge is restricted by rule or danger

motifs.label: Unreliable testimony

motifs.motifeme: reported knowledge conflicts with observation or source reliability

motifs.label: Memory discontinuity

motifs.motifeme: continuity of remembered experience is broken

motifs.label: Secret or powerful name

motifs.motifeme: control or access depends on concealed naming

motifs.label: Deceptive orientation

motifs.motifeme: orientation information systematically misleads

motifs.label: Fragmentary warning

motifs.motifeme: warning arrives incomplete or ambiguous

motifs.label: Lost or broken record

motifs.motifeme: evidence is absent because a record is missing or damaged

motifs.label: Dream as warning or evidence

motifs.motifeme: dream experience functions as warning or evidence

motifs.label: Place agency

motifs.motifeme: place behaves as an intentional participant

motifs.label: Dangerous route

motifs.motifeme: travel path carries persistent supernatural or social danger

motifs.label: Sacred center

motifs.motifeme: spatial center concentrates authority or sacred significance

motifs.label: Dangerous depth

motifs.motifeme: increasing depth crosses into escalating danger

motifs.label: Moving boundary

motifs.motifeme: boundary location or effect shifts over time

motifs.label: Weather as intentional agent

motifs.motifeme: weather is interpreted as intentional agency

motifs.motifeme: burden is transferred onto a substitute bearer

motifs.motifeme: breach of prohibition triggers consequence

motifs.motifeme: ritual action restores acceptable state after contact

motifs.motifeme: costly offering mediates reciprocal exchange

motifs.motifeme: uncertain status is tested through dangerous trial

motifs.label: Binding oath

motifs.motifeme: spoken commitment creates persistent obligation

motifs.motifeme: ritual replaces one bearer, object, or act with another

motifs.motifeme: dead ancestor re-enters present social relations

motifs.motifeme: burden persists across descent relationships

transformationRules.label: Compression
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Remove secondary causes and retain one memorable causal hinge.

transformationRules.label: Personification
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Convert diffuse or impersonal causality into the action of an intentional agent.

transformationRules.label: Ritualization
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Convert remembered response into a repeatable prescribed act.

transformationRules.label: Localization
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Attach a portable narrative to a named local feature, route or ruin.

transformationRules.label: Syncretism
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Merge partially compatible explanatory systems while preserving traces of both.

transformationRules.label: Etiological reframing
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Retell the event primarily as an explanation for why a present condition exists.

transformationRules.label: Moralization
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Reframe contingent outcome as reward or punishment for conduct.

transformationRules.label: Genealogization
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Attach cause, privilege or danger to descent and inherited identity.

transformationRules.label: Demonization
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Interpret ambiguous danger as the intent of a hostile nonhuman agent.

transformationRules.label: Sanctification
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Convert exceptional place, person or rule into a sacred source of authority.

transformationRules.label: Inversion
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Reverse expected roles, values or causal direction to make the account more memorable or polemical.

transformationRules.label: Symbolic substitution
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Replace literal participant or object with a symbol thought to preserve causal equivalence.

transformationRules.label: Authority transfer
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Shift credibility from direct witness to elder, office, archive or ritual specialist.

transformationRules.label: Memorability sharpening
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Favor repeated numbers, stark oppositions and compact causal sequences during transmission.

transformationRules.label: Spatial anchoring
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Attach narrative significance to an observable landmark or route decision.
